s00422.summary: Family and surveyor gather in the empty pool on the day of its sale.
Emmanuel urges his mother to accept the sale while she recalls teaching him to swim.
Joséphine asks to jump and sits beside her grandmother; the men fall quiet.

s01864.summary: Deborah strides into the dreary office with her team and a silent stranger.
Deborah cheerfully spins disastrous Q3 numbers while Sanjay admits the missed target.
Deborah introduces Mr. Lyle, who announces he is there to make cuts.
Lyle takes Deborah aside privately and her composure cracks.
Lyle announces Deborah's leave and unexpectedly puts Sanjay in charge.

s00412.summary: Caspian sits beside lone Josefina at the noodle bar counter.
They trade wary banter about his regular seat and her red coat.
Caspian probes why she sits unseen at the counter and turns toward her.
His nineteen-hour days startle a laugh from Josefina; they tease warmly.
Josefina shares her bowl with Caspian, amazing Basil and Wren.

s00032.summary: Marshal Grainger rides up to a stranded couple at their broken wagon.
Grainger notes the bandaged hand and says the wound looks like teeth.
Grainger lifts the tarp and finds a bloodstained sack.
The couple say together they killed the man because he came for their children.
Grainger drops his gun belt and sits down despite Hannah's rifle.

s02282.summary: Ezekiel sets type in his candlelit printing shop.
Prudence, a mill girl, enters with an unsigned handbill about ten hours.
Ezekiel reads the bill, praises it, and agrees to print it tonight.

s00469.summary: Ingrid and Adebayo run suit and tether checks in the airlock bay.
Ingrid presses him about the light in the crater he downplays as a reflection.
The outer door opens and they step out onto the black surface.

s02175.summary: Noor enters the greenhouse at Imelda's command to remove her shoes.
Imelda deflects Noor's remarks about Teo and unanswered calls with curt replies.
Noor says Marcos called asking whether Imelda plans to sell the house.
Imelda talks of tomatoes and basil for the church supper instead of answering.
Imelda gives Noor a basil plant, saying it will grow toward what light there is.
Father Anselmo and Greta bustle in for the basil.
Noor starts to leave; Imelda gives her a tomato vine for Teo and their fingers linger.
Noor takes her shoes and a seed packet from Teo; Imelda returns to her vines.

s02007.summary: Marguerite and Isaac bicker pointlessly over who should refill the beeping coffee machine.
Leopold arrives and introduces himself as the new efficiency consultant.
Leopold inspects the empty machine and learns nobody is responsible.
Leopold announces two weeks of observation; the others freeze while the machine beeps.

s00529.summary: Wren studies an orchid with a magnifying glass at the show.
A stranger corrects the orchid's label and Wren laughs, delighted.
A steward reminds them to keep to the path; the women exchange conspiratorial glances.
They exchange names and hold hands a beat too long.
Tamsin shyly shows her own hybrid orchid, and Wren urges her not to lose on purpose.

s00101.summary: Six people hold a candlelit séance in a dark radio booth.
The candle bows, the board is dead, and a voice crackles from the speaker.
Marguerite recognizes the dead Vincent's voice as the speaker repeats commands.
Lavinia says the voice is saying Nigel's name and he denies it.
Nigel slams the table; everyone reacts and the booth goes black.
Marguerite lights a match and shows Vincent's cassette, pinning Nigel under everyone's gaze.

s01403.summary: A sweating chef and crew fake readiness as the planner asks about the leaning cake.
After she leaves they fear she knows; a sugar rose falls and Dexter eats it.
The groom asks if the cake should lean and Barnabus calls it a Pisan reference.
The three together lift the cake to carry it out.

s01730.summary: Lucia gets the stubborn machine to accept Delphine's bill, and they trade quiet familiarity.
Norbert phones to say the woman died quickly without waking.
Delphine ends the call and Arlo offers her the first pretzel.

s00595.summary: Cordelia irons while asking packed Maeve to stay past tonight's bus.
Cordelia raises their mother's will and Maeve admits she lied about not reading it.
Cordelia swallows what she wants to say and takes up the iron again.
Maeve says she wanted to hear 'stay', not 'you don't have to go'.
Maeve says goodbye and leaves gently while the soup boils over.
Cordelia lets the iron scorch the tablecloth, watching it burn.

s02178.summary: Sheriff Caleb guards bound Pruitt while Opal taps a dead telegraph key.
Boots gather outside; Pruitt calls out and the telegraph wire proves cut.
Caleb sends Opal out the back door to ride for Fort Hale.
Opal and Caleb share a soft moment and she rides away.
Caleb readies his rifle and tells Pruitt's friends to come in one at a time.

s00624.summary: Four figures wade into the drowned chapel to meet Kestrel.
The Stranger heads for the bell rope; Hollis blocks him and is told he flinches like one who rang it.
Cinder orders Hollis aside and the Stranger takes the rope as Morwenna recognizes him.
Kestrel demands his name; he lowers his hood and says Ambrose Thale.
Ambrose pulls the rope; the water goes still and every flame dies.
Cinder laughs softly; Kestrel relights the lantern and Morwenna unbuckles her keys.

s01400.summary: At a viewing, the family silently notices a stranger with a toddler.
Gabriel crosses to Maeve and demands she leave; she insists she knew the deceased.
Theodora asks the child's name, learns it honors his mother, and silences her sons.
Everyone sits and Theodora puts her arm around the sleeping child.

s00801.summary: Pilot Perpetua steers the balloon over fields, ignoring her nervous passengers.
Arabella screams while Perpetua mutters a quip and Murdoch wakes grumbling.
Fitz and Murdoch joke about the sold house; Arabella begs to land.
A gust shoves the basket, dropping Arabella while Murdoch and Fitz delight.

s00110.summary: A diver climbs the quarry tower and records a dive log.
Isolde confesses her doubts about coaches, letting go, and her reasons for diving.
Isolde replays her words, smiles, and dives into the water.
The abandoned recorder catches a delighted shout from the water.

s00153_0.summary: A gondola cabin hangs over a gorge in icy wind.

s00427.summary: A crew races a countdown to pick a steel case's lock.
The lock opens and the case holds only salted cod.
The truck slows at the checkpoint as the crew reacts in dismay.

s01508.summary: Tamara calmly pilots through a tumbling asteroid field.
She silences her recorded control calls, saying status is lonely.
She threads a gap, turns off the loop for good and heads toward a silver vein.

s01900.summary: Two survivors of a snowmobile wreck meet on cracking ice.
Colleen has Nat crawl low, learns her name, and blames her for the crash.
A crack splits the ice between them, freezing them in place.
Colleen finds rope in Nat's pack and plans to haul her across.
Colleen pulls Nat over the groaning ice and they crawl toward shore.

s01602.summary: Soledad and Sister Agnes tend a dying soldier and decide to operate without plasma.
Colonel Renard storms in through the storm and claims the soldier as his.
Soledad lets Renard watch as she makes the first incision.

s00987.summary: Three men descend in a diving bell, Tobias thrilled and Cornelius uneasy.
A monkfish passes; Archibald warns Tobias away from the glass.
The bell groans and the speaking tube goes dead.
Archibald tugs the signal cord; silence answers, and Tobias jokes grimly.
Archibald hammers the wall, knocks answer, and the bell rises.

s01368.summary: Surgeons and observers sit in the gallery watching a quiet cardiac operation.
Bukowski crinkles a lemon drop wrapper and banters about outliving cardiologists.
Paloma admires the valve and Rao calls it a pump with a door.
Takumi wakes having missed the valve and promises to watch the closing.
The monitor settles and the group watches the closing, Bukowski rationing lemon drops.

s00943.summary: The crew gathers to trace a faint knocking in the ring's walls.
The knocking stops and the crew freezes; Perry insists the wheat is strange.
Lights die, the wall bulges, and everyone scatters toward the hatch.
Bart stares at the thing until Zainab hauls him away and Isolde seals the bulkhead.
Mercator says it isn't wheat while the knocking resumes and Fionnuala laughs shakily.
